response.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_customers_per_employee FROM (SELECT e.EmployeeId, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS cnt FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId) AS per_employee;

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over every row in Employee, so employees with no assigned customers contribute 0. Customers with a NULL SupportRepId are not counted for any employee.
